text: A server checkout whose folder moved: show it as missing and let the server admin point it at the new path
description: Follow-up of b78ef0c0, which covered this machine (recent spaces) and agents. On a server with accounts, a space of kind 'checkout' lives at an operator-given path; when that folder moves, the registry (spaces.json) still points at the old one. Proposal: spaces.list marks such a checkout missing (no .bowman at its path); a server admin gets the same finder (search by the space's id, or a typed path) through an admin-only spaces.relocate. Needs the space's repoId in the registry entry (stored when listed while present), since the meta is gone once the folder is.

status.comment: Built the config way (operator in the terminal, UI view-only): a checkout entry remembers its space's repoId (from meta.json on add and on relocate); spaces.list marks a checkout whose folder holds no .bowman as missing, and the Spaces page shows it red with 'folder moved'; `pnpm spaces list` adds '(folder moved)'; `pnpm spaces relocate <slug> <path> [--force]` (registry relocateCheckout) points the entry at the new folder, refuses another space there (another repoId) unless --force, refuses a path another entry has, refuses created/remote spaces. Entries from before have no repoId, so for them the operator's word counts. No search on the server: the operator knows where they moved it (find_spaces_on_disk covers the local machine). Evidence: backend relocate.test (missing listed, another space refused, relocated by .bowman path, missing gone, --force takes the other space, no space at a path refused), ProjectSelectionView.spec new case (marked failed, 'folder moved'); pnpm check 25/25.
